children: Reference is made to the stock exchange announcement published on 21 September 2026 titled "Goodtech ASA - Vesting under RSU programme and mandatory notification of trade".
The announcement contained an incorrect statement regarding the shareholding of primary insider Johan Håkansson following the vesting and settlement of Matching Shares.

"Johan Håkansson, Director Business Development Sweden, has received 34,482 Matching Shares. Following this, Mr. Håkansson controls 94,478 shares in the Company's share capital and holds 15,200 RSUs."
All other information in the announcement remains unchanged.

This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation and Section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
